exposure: Electroacupuncture (EA) stimulation at LI4 & SP6 combination
cohort: The study included 180 postpartum Cesarean section patients who were split into intervention and control groups.
finding: Electroacupuncture intervention with frequencies of 30, 50, and 100 Hz at LI4, SP6, and LI4&SP6 combination significantly improved the quality of recovery in postpartum Cesarean section patients compared to a control group.
